citation.verbatim: At the Effective Time, each share of Common Stock issued as of immediately prior to the Effective Time shall be automatically subdivided and reclassified into ten (10) validly issued, fully paid and non-assessable shares of Common Stock. Trading is expected to commence on a split-adjusted basis at market open on June 10, 2024.
